title: Measure reply coverage: the responder had read 27 of 78 people who replied
change: Reconciled people who replied in the last 7 days against the replies Togari had read, person by person.
result: Togari read 27 of 78 repliers. The other 51 never reached it, 10 of them opt-outs that had to be blocklisted before Monday.
next_decision: Report coverage (replies handled over people who replied) next to reply rate, and reconcile before any client sees a number.
check: Two sources disagreeing on a reply count is a finding: reconcile person by person before reporting.
scope: Any client whose replies go through a separate responder.
